lines.text: First blood to {winner}! The opening season is in the books, and the rivalry has its first word!
The rivalry has its first chapter, and the name on the cover is {winner}.
Out of the blocks quickest is {winnerClub}, and the opening word belongs to them!
Every great story needs a beginning, and {winner} has just written a fine one.
It starts here! Season one goes to {winnerClub}, and {loserClub} must answer.
The first mark on the board belongs to {winner}, and the board is fresh.
Well, that is how you open a rivalry! {winner} takes the very first season.
{winner} hits the ground running, and {loser} will have plenty to think about.
There is the opening statement: {winnerClub} on top after the first season.
Here we go, then. The first word in this rivalry goes to {winner}.
A rivalry has begun, and it begins with {winnerClub} out in front.
Take note of the name, because it is the first one in the book: {winner}.
The first chapter is written, and {winnerClub} held the pen!
{loser} will want to answer that, and the chance comes soon enough. For now, {winner} leads the way.
The opening bell has rung, and the first punch landed for {winnerClub}!
Season one done, and {winner} has set the standard for everyone to chase.
The first day of a long rivalry, and {winnerClub} have won it.
The curtain rises, and {winner} takes the first bow!
What a start from {winnerClub}! A fast opening, and the first season is theirs.
{winner} by {margin} to open the Showdown, and the rivalry has its first story to tell.
The first result is in, and {winner} is the first name on the winner's board!
This is the start we were waiting for. {winnerClub} take season one!
First out of the traps, {winner}. {loserClub} will be along shortly, you suspect.
Remember this one, because every rivalry remembers how it began. {winnerClub} began it well.
It is a start, nothing more, but what a start for {winner}!
Roll the opening credits, and put {winnerClub} up first.
The scoreboard of this rivalry is no longer empty, and {winner} filled the first line.
{winnerPoints} to {loserPoints} in the first season, and {winner} has made a statement.
They have been waiting to find out who goes first, and the answer is {winnerClub}.
A good beginning is half the work, they say, and {winner} has begun beautifully.
The ink is barely dry on the first page, and {winnerClub} are already in the story.
The first season closes with a smile for {winner} and a long look for {loser}.
Out of the gates in style: {winner} wins the opening season!
Opening night, if you like, and {winnerClub} bring the house down.
Well begun, {winner}! This rivalry will remember who spoke first.
Hats off to {winnerClub}. In the opening season, they were the ones to land first.
The long road starts with a single step, and {winner} took the best one.
This rivalry has its first leader, and it is {winnerClub}.
The first word goes to {winner}, and {loser} is already writing a reply.
There is always one side that gets away fast, and this time it is {winnerClub}!
A tidy beginning for {winner}, and a challenge laid down for {loser}.
Start as you mean to go on, {winner}. Season one is yours!
{winnerClub} take the first season, and the rivalry is officially alive.
Open the book, turn to page one, and read the name: {winner}.
Both sides have shown their hands, and the first season belongs to {winner}.
There is nothing quite like a first win, and {winnerClub} are enjoying every second.
{loserClub} have been given something to chase from the very first season. Thank {winner} for that!
Here is the first line of the rivalry, then: {winner} wins, {loser} follows.
A fine, bold opening from {winner}, and the rivalry is under way!
It begins! {winnerClub} take the opening season, and nothing else has been decided yet.
The first thing anyone will say about this rivalry is that {winner} won the opening round.
It is early, of course, but {winnerClub} could hardly have asked for more.
Season one is finished, and the picture is clear: {winner} fired first.
{loser} gave it a go, but {winner} had the answer in the opening season.
Some openings you forget. This one, with {winnerClub} on top, you will not.
First across the line, and what a fine way to start: {winner}!
Both managers stepped out, and only {winner} stepped out smiling.
One season old, and this rivalry already has a story. {winnerClub} lead it.
Right, we are off! {winner} wins season one, and the Showdown has its first headline.
Where does a rivalry begin? With a winner. In this case, {winnerClub}.
They will tell this tale for seasons to come, and it starts with {winner}.
{winner} will remember this one, and {loser} will remember it too, just for different reasons.
The opener is done, and {winner} is the first to get ahead.
Do not read too much into it, but do not ignore it either. {winnerClub} win season one.
It is the first step in the Showdown, and {winnerClub} have put their best foot forward.
{winner} sets the early pace, and {loser} now has something real to chase.
The dust of the opening season settles, and {winner} is standing tall.
There is a first winner in every rivalry, and in this one it is {winnerClub}!
Feel that? That is the rivalry waking up, and {winner} was the one who woke it.
The very first page of the Showdown carries the name {winnerClub}.
A great way to begin, and a real challenge for {loserClub} to meet.
Now the rivalry has a heartbeat, and it beats in the colors of {winnerClub}!
The opening result lands, and {winner} is the manager with the early say.
Banners up, {winnerClub}! The first season of the Showdown is yours.
The first win is in, and {winner} will treasure it. {loser} will treasure the reply.
Let it be said that {winnerClub} began this rivalry the right way.
It is a quiet start on paper, but a loud one in spirit. {winner} takes the opener.
First things first: {winner} has the first win. Everything else follows.
This is what starting fast looks like. {winnerClub} lead the way.
The rivalry takes its first breath, and {winner} breathes out with a smile.
A debut to remember for {winnerClub}, and the opening chapter is theirs.
There is the early lead, and it belongs to {winner}.
{loser} will not enjoy reading the opening chapter, but {winner} certainly will.
Opening season, opening statement: {winnerClub} mean business!
That is the first one on the board, and what a feeling it must be for {winner}.
If you want to know who started well, look no further than {winnerClub}.
A rivalry like this needs a first move, and {winner} made it with confidence.
Little by little, season by season, a rivalry is built. {winner} has laid the first stone.
{winnerClub} start in front, and the rest of the Showdown has to find a way past.
The Showdown is born, and {winner} is its first winner!
Think of it as the first frame of a long film. {winnerClub} are in it, front and center.
A first win to savor for {winner}, and a good one to build on.
Not a bad way to start a rivalry, {winner}. Not bad at all!
And there it is, the very first result. {winner} leads, and {loser} follows.
Somebody had to go first, and {winnerClub} did it with real style!
Early days, yes, but {winner} has the look of a manager who came to play.
The very first whistle of the rivalry has blown, and {winner} is the happier of the two.
From a blank page to a first result, and {winnerClub} are the name on it.
No history yet between these two, but there is a first line now, and {winner} wrote it.
Fair play to {loser}, who pushed hard. The opening word, though, goes to {winner}.
